prompt.zh-TW: 初陽貿易今年本期進貨 {{money:vars.purchases}}，年底應付帳款 {{money:vars.ap}}；應付款項週轉率（Excel 版）從去年的 {{number:vars.last|digits=2,unit=times}} 降到今年的 {{number:vars.now|digits=2,unit=times}}（見上表），兩年的進貨金額差不多。哪一個判讀最合理？
prompt.en: First Light Trading made purchases of {{money:vars.purchases}} this year and had trade payables of {{money:vars.ap}} at year end; its payables turnover (Excel version) fell from {{number:vars.last|digits=2,unit=times}} last year to {{number:vars.now|digits=2,unit=times}} this year (see the table above), with purchases about the same. Which reading is most reasonable?

text.zh-TW: 付款變慢，等於多用了供應商的錢來週轉，但要留意供應商關係
text.en: Paying more slowly means using more of suppliers’ money, but it should watch its supplier relationships

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。應付帳款是免息的資金來源，但不是沒有代價：短期內現金壓力減輕，供應商關係與信用條件卻可能變差。
feedback.en: That’s right. Trade payables are an interest-free source of funding, but not a free one: cash pressure eases in the short term, while supplier relationships and credit terms may deteriorate.

text.zh-TW: 付款變慢代表供應商給了更多折扣，對公司是好事
text.en: Paying more slowly means suppliers are giving bigger discounts, which is good for the company

feedback.zh-TW: 折扣通常是給付款快的客戶。付款變慢更可能是公司自己想留住現金，或現金不夠。
feedback.en: Discounts usually go to customers who pay quickly. Slower payment more likely means the company wants to hold on to cash, or does not have enough.

text.zh-TW: 週轉率下降，表示年底欠供應商的應付帳款變少了
text.en: A lower turnover means the trade payables owed to suppliers at year end have fallen

feedback.zh-TW: 你從分母去想，方向對。不過進貨差不多、週轉率下降，表示分母的應付帳款變大，不是變少。
feedback.en: Thinking about the denominator is the right direction. But with purchases about the same, a lower turnover means payables in the denominator grew, not shrank.

explanation.zh-TW: {{term:tm_2jyfy0hn}}下降代表付款週期拉長。{{option:o_g038}}同時看到好處與代價；{{option:o_qtc6}}把折扣和付款速度的關係弄反，{{option:o_zpcr}}把分母的方向讀錯。
explanation.en: A falling {{term:tm_2jyfy0hn}} means a longer payment cycle. {{option:o_g038}} sees both the benefit and the cost; {{option:o_qtc6}} gets the link between discounts and payment speed backwards, and {{option:o_zpcr}} misreads the direction of the denominator.
